purpose: Machine-readable DUFYND product visual fidelity queue. `items` contains active blocking reviews; `approved_product_truth` records human-approved DUFYND-generated assets promoted after fidelity review.
rules: P0 items in `items` must not be promoted to verified primary product depictions until resolved.
Human fidelity approval never grants rights to external manufacturer or retailer imagery.
DUFYND-generated internal candidates may be promoted only after explicit human fidelity approval and must retain generated-asset provenance.
A promoted replacement must preserve the exact product variant and bottle size.
Pending candidate assets must remain outside the storefront public directory until they pass the fidelity gate.
